$comment: TODO: Replace every TODO_ placeholder before running the demo.
provider: credential/rollup label — must match control-plane.json credentials.providers key.
model: the exact string sent on the wire as 'model'; a wrong id fails the turn, not the boot.
wire_protocol: 'openai_responses' for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (including NVIDIA NIM).
half_life_ms: prefix KV half-life in ms (300000 = 5 min).
max_ttl_ms: hard ceiling on how long roundhouse treats a prefix as cached.
min_prefix_tokens: prefix shorter than this is not tracked (no cache credit).
pricing: REPLACE WITH REAL RATES from openrouter.ai or your provider's rate card.
quality_prior: normalize a published intelligence index to 0.0..1.0 and record snapshot date.
correlaries: list peer entries for local-vs-frontier savings comparison.
Both models must be within capability_band (default 0.10) for the gate to allow pricing.
local_quality: map of local model id -> quality_prior for local fleet entries.
capability_band: max |quality_prior| delta between two models that can be priced against each other.
